coverageMeaning.local: Construct or inspect candidates locally; no remote change.
coverageMeaning.public-api: Includes explicitly selected Fabric Plan definition operations.
coverageMeaning.guide-only: Scope and limitations only; no executable operation.

integrated-variance.description: Style a locally supplied comparison while preserving bindings.
integrated-variance.inputs: Current comparison properties with resolved actual and baseline roles.

build.command: python plan.py build --model current-model.json --spec application.json --out draft

forecast.inputs: Actuals key, horizon and ordered calendar fields.
forecast.command: python plan.py build --model current-model.json --spec forecast.json --out draft

export.inputs: Authorized destination config and Plan ID.
export.command: python plan.py api export --config destination.json --run run --label baseline

create.description: Create a new Plan from a complete definition.
create.inputs: Authorized workspace, display name and definition.
create.command: python plan.py api create --config destination.json --payload definition.json --run run --label create

update.inputs: Authorized destination, Plan ID and complete candidate.
update.command: python plan.py api update --config destination.json --payload candidate.json --run run --label update

input.inputs: Owner, input type, unit, default and edit policy.
input.command: python plan.py construct-native input --input input.request.json --out input.payload.json

formula.command: python plan.py construct-native formula --input formula.request.json --out formula.payload.json

filters.command: python plan.py build --model current-model.json --spec application.json --out draft

mapping.inputs: Current fields, ordered axes and stable keys.
mapping.command: python plan.py construct-native dimension-mapping --input mapping.request.json --out mapping.json

rule.inputs: Rule type, target scope and current measure IDs.
rule.command: python plan.py construct-native rule --input rule.request.json --out rule.payload.json

weighted-rule.inputs: Source amount, target grain, weight measure and total policy.
weighted-rule.command: python plan.py construct-native weighted-rule --input weighted-rule.request.json --out rule.payload.json

bridge-source.command: python plan.py construct-bridge planning-source --input source.request.json --out source.json

bridge-construct-query.command: python plan.py construct-bridge query --input bridge.request.json --out bridge.json

bridge-append.command: python plan.py construct-bridge append --input bridge.request.json --out bridge.json

bridge-merge.inputs: Supplied left/right fields and join keys.
bridge-merge.command: python plan.py construct-bridge merge --input bridge.request.json --out bridge.json

bridge-join.inputs: Supplied source definitions, join type and key mapping.
bridge-join.command: python plan.py construct-bridge join --input bridge.request.json --out bridge.json

bridge-sql.inputs: Resolved SQL source identity and schema.
bridge-sql.command: python plan.py construct-bridge sql --input bridge.request.json --out bridge.json

bridge-consumer.inputs: Current query and post-transform output metadata.
bridge-consumer.command: python plan.py construct-native bridge-consumer --input consumer.request.json --out consumer.json

check-bridge-mappings.inputs: Graph with current source and output identities.

powertable.description: Construct table definition parts in Python.
powertable.inputs: Authorized source identity, physical schema and column configuration.

table-source.inputs: Database, connection and physical table identity.
table-source.command: python plan.py construct-native powertable-source --input source.request.json --out source.json

table-column.inputs: Physical column metadata, key role and editing policy.
table-column.command: python plan.py construct-native table-column --input column.request.json --out column.json

table-config-repair.description: Prepare a scoped lookup/source metadata change.
table-config-repair.inputs: Current definition, destination metadata and approved change.
table-config-repair.command: python plan.py repair-powertable-config --baseline current-definition.json --input repair.request.json --out candidate

format-matrix.inputs: Current state, selected measures, conditions and requested appearance.

leaf-key-mapping.description: Map storage to stable leaf keys.
leaf-key-mapping.inputs: Ordered axes, field IDs and verified dependencies.

resolve-measure-binding.description: Resolve a supplied model, sheet or query binding.
resolve-measure-binding.inputs: Typed source request and current metadata for its owner.

planning-totals.description: Set the requested placement of totals.
planning-totals.inputs: Current Planning properties and intended axis settings.

roll-forward-presentation.inputs: Resolved measures, hierarchy and current properties.

plan-intent.description: Route a structured business brief locally.
plan-intent.inputs: Original request, requirements, evidence and dependencies.

planning-time-axis.description: Construct or inspect a calendar axis.
planning-time-axis.inputs: Model fields, ordered hierarchy and calendar choices.

planning-time-column.inputs: Baseline definition, resolved source, cutoff and period grain.
planning-time-column.command: python plan.py planning-time-column --baseline definition.json --input request.json --out result

repair-formula-equality.description: Repair comparison operators in a candidate.

check-import-contract.description: Compare requested inputs, formulas and rules with the candidate.
check-import-contract.command: python plan.py check-import-contract --spec application.json --construction draft/construction.json --candidate candidate.json --out import-contract.json

anchor-construct.description: Attach an anchor at the decision grain.
anchor-construct.inputs: Current ordered pivot dimensions and selected measure.
anchor-construct.command: python plan.py construct-native anchor --input REQUEST --out CANDIDATE

planning-column-presentation.description: Prepare column sizing and expansion settings.

planning-display-defaults.description: Prepare numeric display and card defaults.

chart-filter-audit.description: Audit visible field cards and assignment identity in Python.

modules.name: Build, export, create or update a Plan
businessRequests: Build, export, create or update a Plan
modules.prerequisites: Resolve the model, target and authorized identity before API calls.
modules.limitations: Local validation and API completion do not validate calculated values.

modules.name: Preserve requested inputs, formulas and rules on import
businessRequests: Preserve requested inputs, formulas and rules on import
modules.prerequisites: Keep the original spec and current complete definition.
modules.limitations: A local contract check does not execute grid queries.

modules.name: Decompose a planning request into decisions
businessRequests: Decompose a planning request into decisions
modules.prerequisites: Retain the original business clauses and unresolved decisions.
modules.limitations: Routing is not delivery.

modules.name: Lay out a Planning sheet
businessRequests: Lay out a Planning sheet
modules.prerequisites: Resolve the sheet and ordered axes.
modules.limitations: Presentation does not change calculation grain.

modules.name: Choose source aggregation and grid totals
businessRequests: Choose source aggregation and grid totals
modules.prerequisites: Resolve metric units and behavior across each axis.
modules.limitations: Rates and balances are not additive by default.

modules.name: Add typed inputs and commentary
businessRequests: Add typed inputs and commentary
modules.prerequisites: Identify the decision grain, type and eligibility.
modules.limitations: A constructed input does not prove writeback.

modules.name: Plan a rolling forecast and time extension
businessRequests: Plan a rolling forecast and time extension
modules.prerequisites: Identify actuals, cutoff, end date, calendar and open-period policy.
modules.limitations: Forecast definition construction does not populate cells.

modules.name: Calculate period-to-date values and one-time columns
businessRequests: Calculate period-to-date values and one-time columns
modules.prerequisites: Identify the ordered period key, source and cutoff scope.
modules.limitations: Do not treat absent actuals as zeros.

modules.name: Model measures by business role
businessRequests: Model measures by business role
modules.prerequisites: Distinguish source, editable and calculated values.
modules.limitations: Grouping measures does not change their arithmetic.

modules.name: Specify approval stages
businessRequests: Specify approval stages
modules.prerequisites: Identify workflow stages, actors and required audit trail.
modules.limitations: Approval workflows are not implemented by this package.

modules.name: Define conditional formatting for a Planning matrix
aliases: CF rules missing in Manage Rules
businessRequests: Define conditional formatting for a Planning matrix
modules.prerequisites: Resolve target, comparator, favorable direction and scope.
modules.limitations: Compiled rules do not prove UI rendering.

modules.name: Define conditional formatting for a Planning matrix
aliases: CF rules missing in Manage Rules
businessRequests: Define conditional formatting for a Planning matrix
modules.prerequisites: Resolve target, comparator, favorable direction and scope.
modules.limitations: Compiled rules do not prove UI rendering.

modules.name: Transform Planning sources with InfoBridge
businessRequests: Transform Planning sources with InfoBridge
modules.prerequisites: Supply source schemas, grain and output identities.
modules.limitations: Local construction does not run SQL, refresh data or materialize results.

modules.name: Reuse values from sheets or queries
businessRequests: Reuse values from sheets or queries
modules.prerequisites: Resolve current source owner, measure or output ID and compatible grain.
modules.limitations: A matching caption does not establish a binding.

modules.name: Anchor a shared assumption at its decision grain
aliases: regional benefits hidden employee leaf formulas
product price policy shared across regions
hide repeated assumptions at hierarchy levels
businessRequests: Anchor a shared assumption at its decision grain
modules.prerequisites: Resolve all ordered pivot fields and selected anchor dimensions.
modules.limitations: An anchor is neither a lookup nor an allocation rule.

modules.name: Bind model measures and numeric columns
businessRequests: Bind model measures and numeric columns
modules.prerequisites: Identify the physical field and source aggregation.
modules.limitations: A grid total setting does not select source aggregation.

modules.name: Specify access control requirements
businessRequests: Specify access control requirements
modules.prerequisites: Identify the protected scope, actors and authorized policy owner.
modules.limitations: A filter is not an access control. No permission-management action is exposed.

modules.name: Allow input based on a formula
businessRequests: Allow input based on a formula
modules.prerequisites: Resolve the editable target and positive Boolean condition.
modules.limitations: Eligibility does not grant user access.

modules.name: Model, configure and analyze PowerTable sources
businessRequests: Model, configure and analyze PowerTable sources
modules.prerequisites: Supply physical schema, keys and authorized source identity.
modules.limitations: No SQL provisioning, row write, schema discovery or connection setup is performed.

modules.name: Allocate amounts and distribute by weight
businessRequests: Allocate amounts and distribute by weight
modules.prerequisites: Identify weights, grain, units and zero-weight policy.
modules.limitations: Local payload construction does not calculate allocations.

modules.name: Map dimensions to stable storage keys
businessRequests: Map dimensions to stable storage keys
modules.prerequisites: Confirm leaf uniqueness and ancestor dependencies.
modules.limitations: A candidate mapping does not migrate existing cell values.

modules.name: Construct formulas for calculated measures
businessRequests: Construct formulas for calculated measures
modules.prerequisites: Resolve referenced IDs and aggregation semantics.
modules.limitations: Syntax checks are not a calculation engine.

modules.name: Check and repair formula equality
businessRequests: Check and repair formula equality
modules.prerequisites: Identify a Planning expression, not SQL or DAX.
modules.limitations: The checker is scoped to the equality operator.

modules.name: Distinguish scenario inputs from lifecycle and access
businessRequests: Distinguish scenario inputs from lifecycle and access
modules.prerequisites: Determine whether a transient filter or stored version is requested.
modules.limitations: No scenario lifecycle management is implemented.

modules.name: Carry opening balances through movements to closing balances
aliases: staffing exits depend on opening headcount
businessRequests: Carry opening balances through movements to closing balances
modules.prerequisites: Resolve the seed, ordered calendar, signed movements and per-axis aggregation.
modules.limitations: The generic builder does not implement cyclic measure graphs.

modules.name: Fit Planning headers, number displays and matrix columns
businessRequests: Fit Planning headers, number displays and matrix columns
modules.prerequisites: Start from current properties and preserve user choices.
modules.limitations: Local size estimates do not verify viewport rendering.

modules.name: Check chart visual filters on local definitions
businessRequests: Check that each assigned chart field has its own unrestricted card.
modules.prerequisites: Supply current chart properties and resolved assignments.
modules.limitations: The audit checks metadata only, not rendering or workspace state.
